phases.name: Preboarding and Preparation
phases.objective: Prepare administrative information, equipment, accounts, and the employee's first-week schedule.

tasks.title: Confirm employee onboarding information
tasks.description: Verify the employee's role, department, manager, start date, location, employment type, and preferred language.

tasks.title: Prepare workstation and equipment
tasks.description: Prepare the approved laptop, accessories, and any role-required development equipment.

tasks.title: Create core company accounts
tasks.description: Create the employee's approved company identity, email, communication, HR, and identity-provider accounts.

tasks.title: Prepare first-week agenda
tasks.description: Schedule orientation, team introductions, manager sessions, security training, and role setup activities.

phases.name: Welcome and Core Setup
phases.objective: Welcome the employee and complete essential administrative, security, and access setup.

tasks.title: Complete HR welcome session
tasks.description: Present essential HR processes, working arrangements, internal support channels, and onboarding expectations.
completion_criteria: Employee knows the main HR support channels

tasks.title: Complete equipment handover
tasks.description: Provide the assigned workstation and confirm that the employee can sign in securely.

tasks.title: Complete mandatory security and privacy training
tasks.description: Complete required training covering password security, phishing, confidential information, privacy, and acceptable use.

tasks.title: Meet the team and onboarding buddy
tasks.description: Introduce the employee to the team, key collaborators, manager, and assigned onboarding buddy.

tasks.title: Align on role expectations
tasks.description: Review responsibilities, initial objectives, communication practices, success indicators, and the onboarding plan.

phases.name: Engineering Access and Development Environment
phases.objective: Provide approved engineering access and establish a functioning local development environment.

tasks.title: Grant approved engineering access
tasks.description: Grant access to the approved source-control organization, project tracker, documentation platform, design workspace, and development communication channels.
completion_criteria: Design workspace access works when required

tasks.title: Review engineering security practices
tasks.description: Review repository permissions, secrets handling, branch protection, dependency security, and rules for production access.

tasks.title: Set up the local development environment
tasks.description: Install approved tools, clone the required repositories, configure the local environment, and start the application according to internal documentation.

tasks.title: Validate the development environment
tasks.description: Validate the local setup with the onboarding buddy and resolve blocking configuration issues.
completion_criteria: Blocking setup issues are resolved or documented

phases.name: Product, Architecture, and Codebase Introduction
phases.objective: Build sufficient product and technical context before independent delivery.

tasks.title: Complete product and customer overview
tasks.description: Review the product purpose, principal users, important workflows, and the frontend team's responsibilities.
completion_criteria: Main product workflows can be explained

tasks.title: Review frontend architecture
tasks.description: Review the application structure, state management, API integration, routing, component conventions, testing approach, styling system, localization, and deployment flow.
completion_criteria: Testing and styling conventions are understood

tasks.title: Review engineering delivery workflow
tasks.description: Review ticket refinement, branching, commits, pull requests, reviews, automated checks, QA, release, and incident-reporting practices.
completion_criteria: QA and release responsibilities are understood

tasks.title: Complete guided codebase exploration
tasks.description: Trace one representative user journey through frontend components, state, API calls, and backend integration.
completion_criteria: A representative user journey is traced
Relevant modules and integrations are identified

tasks.title: Complete first-week checkpoint
tasks.description: Review access, environment readiness, role understanding, blockers, and adjustments required for the remaining plan.

phases.name: Guided Role Contribution
phases.objective: Apply team conventions through a limited, reviewable contribution.

tasks.title: Select the first guided engineering task
tasks.description: Select a low-risk frontend task with clear scope, acceptance criteria, and an available reviewer.

tasks.title: Implement the first guided frontend task
tasks.description: Implement the selected task using the team's frontend, accessibility, localization, testing, and code-quality conventions.
completion_criteria: Relevant tests are added or updated
Accessibility and responsive behavior are checked

tasks.title: Complete review and feedback cycle
tasks.description: Address review feedback and document important project conventions learned from the first contribution.
completion_criteria: Contribution is approved or ready for final validation

tasks.title: Complete targeted role-skill learning
tasks.description: Complete targeted learning selected from verified skill gaps or required project technologies.
completion_criteria: A practical application or summary is produced

exclude_when: No verified skill gap or required learning exists

tasks.title: Complete progress checkpoint
tasks.description: Review contribution quality, technical understanding, collaboration, blockers, and the next level of responsibility.

phases.name: Increasing Independence and Final Review
phases.objective: Demonstrate increasing autonomy and establish post-onboarding development objectives.

tasks.title: Complete a second role-based contribution
tasks.description: Complete a moderately scoped frontend contribution with reduced supervision and full adherence to delivery standards.
completion_criteria: Task is delivered with reduced supervision
Tests and documentation are updated when required

tasks.title: Document onboarding learning and remaining questions
tasks.description: Summarize product knowledge, technical conventions, useful resources, remaining questions, and proposed documentation improvements.
completion_criteria: At least one documentation improvement is proposed when applicable

tasks.title: Complete 30-day onboarding review
tasks.description: Evaluate onboarding completion, access readiness, role understanding, delivery progress, support needs, and development objectives.
completion_criteria: Plan completion is recommended or an extension is proposed

tasks.title: Validate onboarding completion
tasks.description: Verify that mandatory administrative, access, security, training, and review tasks are complete.

milestones.title: Thirty-day onboarding completed
success_criteria: Employee can perform expected initial responsibilities
The employee has the approved equipment and access required for the role
Mandatory administrative and security activities are complete
The local development environment is operational
The employee understands the product and frontend architecture
At least one reviewed role-based contribution is completed
Manager and HR completion reviews are recorded

adaptation_rules.action: Reduce introductory technical training and replace it with architecture, ownership, and system-level tasks

adaptation_rules.condition: profile_context.skill_gaps contains a skill required by knowledge_context
adaptation_rules.action: Add or prioritize targeted learning and a practical task for the verified skill gap
Delay dependent practical tasks and add an access-resolution checkpoint
